description:
Oh no! Rabbit is looking for a new home, but he has so many carrots they just won't fit anywhere. Read along as Rabbit tries different homes to fit all his carrots. This makes a great spring book read aloud for kids. Books read aloud for kids are our favorite. This is a great bunny book read aloud and just in time for Easter.
